compiler.help: Tectonic is built in and needs no setup. The other choices run system TeX, which can read local files available to your account and should be used only with trusted projects. Auto picks the compiler from the source. pdfLaTeX matches most journal templates. XeLaTeX and LuaLaTeX add system fonts and Unicode.
compiler.title: Compiler (this project)

compile.texRootBroken: % !TEX root in {{file}} points to a missing file ({{target}})

enginePicker.descriptionCompileFailure: The failure matches a known gap in the bundled Tectonic engine. Pick how this project should compile. The choice is saved in the project, so collaborators get the same setup.
enginePicker.descriptionImportScan: The import scan found features the bundled Tectonic engine does not orchestrate. Pick how this project should compile. The choice is saved in the project, so collaborators get the same setup.

shellEscape.label: Allow external commands on this computer
shellEscape.needed: This project uses features that need arbitrary external commands. They stay blocked until you allow them.
shellEscape.warning: Required by minted and some PythonTeX documents. LaTeX can run programs with your user permissions, so enable this only for a project you trust. TeX Live's own helpers, like EPS conversion, run without it.

enginePicker.shellEscapeAllowed: External commands are allowed for this project on this computer.
enginePicker.shellEscapeBlocked: Arbitrary external commands are blocked for this project. TeX Live's own helpers, like EPS conversion, still run.
enginePicker.shellEscapeFailed: Could not update external command access.

enginePicker.switchedAfterInstall: TinyTeX installed. This project now compiles with {{engine}}.

systemTex.found: A TeX distribution was found on this machine. System TeX can read local files available to your account, so use it only with projects you trust. Arbitrary external commands stay blocked unless you allow them below. TeX Live still runs the helpers on its own allow list, like EPS conversion.

cloud.description: Keep projects synchronized across your devices without configuring a Git remote. Every transfer will be end-to-end encrypted, so your work stays private in transit. Your local project folders will remain the source of truth.
cloud.title: Cloud sync

data.githubHint: Back up or sync a project across devices: connect GitHub, then use <push>Push</push> / <pull>Pull</pull> in Source Control. <setup>Set up GitHub →</setup>
data.localFirst: Oleafly is local-first. All projects live on your disk:
data.plainFolders: Each project is a plain folder. Git history is optional, and nothing leaves your machine unless you push to GitHub.

latexTools.description: Show the Oleafly Tools gallery and the individual tools (PDF import, equations, tables, BibTeX, lab and literature search, deadlines) plus their slash commands. Off by default while still in beta.
latexTools.label: LaTeX tools

visualEditor.description: Show the Visual/Code toggle in the document editor. Off by default, so documents open in the code editor only. Diagrams always keep their own canvas toggle.
visualEditor.label: Visual editor

experimentation.warning: These features are experimental and still in beta. They are not fully tested yet and may change, break, or be removed in a future release. Turn them on only if you want to try work in progress.

webBrowser.description: Show the in-app web browser (its dock toggle and shortcut) and let the AI drive it with computer use. Off by default while still in beta; when off, there is no browser button and the AI has no browser tool.
webBrowser.label: Web browser

dialect.description: Apply the selected spelling, grammar, and regional conventions.
dialect.label: English dialect

dictionary.description: Exact offline Hunspell pack used by Source and Visual spelling checks.
dictionary.label: Spelling dictionary

harper.description: Check English grammar and style in LaTeX and Markdown Source and Visual editing, plus Typst Source, with one-click fixes.
harper.label: Grammar & style (Harper)

offline.description: Compile with --only-cached and never fetch packages over the network.
offline.label: Offline mode

general.proofreadingNote: Proofreading runs locally in a background worker. Harper follows the selected English dialect; spelling always uses the exact selected Hunspell pack. Math, code, comments, citation syntax, metadata, and URLs are excluded.

regionalism.description: Flag terms that do not match the selected English dialect. Turn off if you use such terms as product or code names.
regionalism.label: Regionalism suggestions

spellcheck.description: Underline misspelled words with the selected offline Hunspell dictionary and offer replacement suggestions in Source and Visual editing.
spellcheck.label: Spellcheck

wordChoice.description: Suggest alternative words (e.g. “too” vs. “to”). Turn off to keep only spelling and grammar.
wordChoice.label: Word-choice suggestions

help.support: If Oleafly helps your work, please <star>star the project on GitHub</star>. That small click helps more researchers find it and supports continued development.
help.tagline: Write, compile, proofread, manage citations, review PDFs, track changes in Git, and use the AI models you choose. All in one open-source workspace.
